title: Valar Atomics statement
description: A quiet, window-tall statement on the page grey: a short tight heading and a muted paragraph ending in a bold punchline, centred between two thin gold brackets with chamfered bumps (left and right on desktop, above and below on phones). The text is blurred and faint until it scrolls up into focus.
notes: the blur-to-focus is a CSS view timeline (no JS) and reaches full focus when the section is near the middle of the window: don't make it the page's last section
the original's faint lattice texture behind the brackets is left out (artwork)
